rules.statement: When editing an existing file, keep its original encoding and byte order mark (for example the UTF-8 BOM on a Visual Studio .sln file) so the diff shows only the intended content changes.
rules.why: Dropping or adding a BOM as a side effect makes the diff noisier and changes the file's encoding, and Visual Studio may re-add the BOM on its next save, which leaves another unrelated diff.
rules.check: Look for a first-line change in an edited file where only an invisible BOM (U+FEFF) was added or removed, especially in .sln, .csproj or other IDE-managed files, when the PR doesn't say it changes the encoding.
